title: lathyrus elongatus
intro: Lathyrus elongatus, commonly known as the 'Sweet pea' or 'Flat-pea', is a flowering plant that belongs to the legume family and is native to Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Lathyrus elongatus include its high nutritional value, which makes it an excellent source of protein, fiber, and vitamins. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus elongatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
